thread:
Rhea P.: Quick design sync: API Keys page — need final decisions on wording (Disable vs Deactivate vs Revoke), primary CTA placement, and mobile tappable areas. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frame: 'Keys List - Final'). Diego V.: Create should be primary and left-aligned. Rotation is a secondary action. Priya S.: Copy: prefer 'Disable' for reversible actions, 'Permanently revoke' for irreversible. Keeps expectations clear. Evan T.: Accessibility: when the revoke dialog opens, focus must land on the dialog title and the reason text must be announced. aria-modal=true, trap focus. Priya S.: Modal microcopy proposal: Title: 'Permanently revoke this API key?'; body: 'This will immediately stop all requests using the key and cannot be undone.' Danger CTA: 'Permanently revoke key' (red). Secondary: 'Cancel'. Rhea P.: Can we add an undo toast for 10s after revoke: 'Key revoked — undo'? Backend said soft-delete exists. Evan T.: Toast snippet:
Key revoked — undo
. Use assertive for errors. Diego V.: Mobile: increase kebab hit target to 44x44. Consider moving Create into a sticky footer on small screens. Priya S.: Empty states: Admins see 'No API keys yet. Create a key to start using Redwood.' Members see 'You don't have any API keys. Request one from your org admin.' ux-bot: Running microcopy experiment: variant A uses 'Deactivate' for soft action, variant B uses 'Disable' (exp: key_copy_v9). Rhea P.: Thanks — I'll update Figma with the chosen microcopy and add an accessibility checklist. Please drop any last comments there by EOD tomorrow.
